name: Firsthand Editorial Team
bio: Firsthand's editorial team fact-checks every travel article against the primary sources it cites: U.S. Department of Transportation rules and consumer protection pages, insurers' official plan documents and policy wording, manufacturers' published specifications and warranty terms, and airlines' and providers' official policy pages: before publication. Firsthand Travel does NOT take press trips, file insurance claims, lab-test gear, or survey travelers, and it is not an insurance agency or broker: our ratings are based on analysis of officially published documentation, and this is editorial fact-checking against primary sources, not first-hand testing or an independent audit. Where pricing is quote-based or varies by state, we say so rather than presenting a single number as universal.
